import openpyxl
import os

out_path = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(out_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Read all data rows (rows 3-16, since row 2 is header)
# We need to deduplicate based on Column A only, keeping first occurrence
seen = set()
kept_rows = []

for row in range(3, 17):
    a_val = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if a_val is not None and a_val in seen:
        continue  # skip duplicate
    if a_val is not None:
        seen.add(a_val)
    # Collect all 10 column values for this row
    row_data = [ws.cell(row=row, column=c).value for c in range(1, 11)]
    kept_rows.append(row_data)

# Write kept rows back starting at row 3
for i, row_data in enumerate(kept_rows):
    for j, val in enumerate(row_data):
        ws.cell(row=3 + i, column=1 + j).value = val

# Clear any remaining rows beyond the kept data (up to row 16)
for row in range(3 + len(kept_rows), 17):
    for col in range(1, 11):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

wb.save(out_path)
print(f"Kept {len(kept_rows)} rows, cleared rows {3 + len(kept_rows)} to 16")
